description.value: Cap's Liquor Store is a cold beer, wine, and spirits retailer located on Harvey Ave in Kelowna, affiliated with the Coast Capri Hotel. It carries a broad selection of beer, coolers, ciders, spirits, and wines and offers an online shop for browsing inventory. For touring cyclists passing through Kelowna, it is a convenient stop to pick up beverages for camp or the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms the business is an operational liquor store at 1171 Harvey Ave, Kelowna, with phone +1 250-862-2441. The email domain (coastcaprihotel.com) indicates an affiliation with the Coast Capri Hotel. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, pump, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields default to null.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only.

No postal code available in the address as listed on the website.
Website copyright reads 2020 and online checkout is disabled; site may not be actively maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cap's is a functioning retail liquor store and a plausible convenience stop for touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence. A site visit or direct outreach is needed before inclusion.
